guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Tasks Portal
guide.description: Open the Kryvora Quests & Points Portal and connect an EVM wallet. Add Kryvora Network to your wallet when prompted (Chain ID 73829164).
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Your Wallet to the Tasks Portal
guide.original_description: Open the Kryvora Quests & Points Portal and connect an EVM wallet. Add Kryvora Network to your wallet when prompted (Chain ID 73829164).

guide.title: Claim a Daily Check-In
guide.description: Check in on the portal for +50 PTS. Daily check-ins build your streak, so return every day.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Check in on the portal for +50 PTS. Daily check-ins build your streak, so return every day.

guide.title: Link Your Socials and Join Discord
guide.description: Connect your X and Discord accounts, then complete the social quests: Follow, repost, and quote @KryvoraNetwork on X Join the Kryvora Discord server For tips on earning server roles, see our Discord role farming guide .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Link Your Socials and Join Discord
guide.original_description: Connect your X and Discord accounts, then complete the social quests: Follow, repost, and quote @KryvoraNetwork on X Join the Kryvora Discord server For tips on earning server roles, see our Discord role farming guide .

guide.title: Get Testnet ETH
guide.description: Request test ETH from the Kryvora faucet . You can also bridge Sepolia ETH to the Kryvora testnet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Request test ETH from the Kryvora faucet . You can also bridge Sepolia ETH to the Kryvora testnet.

guide.title: Complete Onchain Tasks
guide.description: Go to the Kryvora dApps page and work through the onchain quests: Swap tokens Add liquidity to a pool Supply assets to the lending market Deploy a smart contract
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Kryvora dApps page and work through the onchain quests: Swap tokens Add liquidity to a pool Supply assets to the lending market Deploy a smart contract

guide.title: Mint a Testnet NFT
guide.description: Visit the Kryvora NFT page and mint a Nuke Genesis or Verdant Core NFT to complete the NFT quest.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Visit the Kryvora NFT page and mint a Nuke Genesis or Verdant Core NFT to complete the NFT quest.

guide.title: Invite Friends
guide.description: Share your referral link from the portal. Three active invites earn +200 PTS.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Share your referral link from the portal. Three active invites earn +200 PTS.

guide.title: Run a Genesis Node (Optional)
guide.description: This is the only paid step. A Genesis Node Key costs about 10 USDC on Arbitrum and can be minted at the Kryvora Node page . After minting, self-host the node or use the 1-click cloud option on Node Hub . You can buy USDC on Bybit . If your funds sit on another chain, move them to Arbitrum with the widget below.
